scheduled_slots: All regular minute starts m>=540 with m+1<=BUY_INTENT cutoff; 540<=m<690 or750<=m<925. Lunch and closing auction excluded, same certified active-time calendar as C01.
bin_assignment: Index j of a minute in the cutoff-known sorted scheduled_slots, total N. Bin=floor(8*j/N). No observed-count or outcome-based bin boundaries.
observed_membership: Only actual same-day prefix bars with start+1<=cutoff, whose start is a scheduled slot. No interpolation.
empty_bin: observed_count=0; scheduled_count factual; support_fraction=0 if scheduled_count>0, else null; other summaries null, including gap_pair_count.
nonempty_bin: net_progress=log(last observed C/first observed O), range=log(maxH/minL), actual Vo/Va mean, nonflat candle body/wick averages, gap count among observed neighbors in the same bin using same-half exact one-minute adjacency.
